max_fee_cap.meaning: DynamicSwapFeeModule.MAX_FEE_CAP, the configured maximum dynamic fee cap, reported as 500,000 (50%).

dynamic_fee_applied.meaning: the dynamic fee mechanism applies a dynamically calculated fee rather than falling back to basic tick spacing fees

falls_back_to_basic_tick_spacing_fees.meaning: the system always falls back to basic tick spacing fees instead of applying a dynamically calculated fee

assumptions: The dynamic fee mechanism is expected to be invoked during swap fee calculation.

unresolved.description: Report does not state the numeric dynamic fee value or the exact condition under which the dynamic fee would be applied versus falling back, so the applicability condition of the intent is represented only by the grounded Boolean dynamic_fee_applied.

limitations: The intent's applicability condition is encoded as a Boolean occurrence symbol because the report does not give a numeric definition of when dynamic fees are applied.
The impact is encoded as a Boolean outcome because the report does not specify the exact fallback fee value or tick spacing default.
